description:
Itsy Bitsy Spider: How Spiders Climb Smooth Water Spouts! — The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout! Ever wonder why spiders NEVER slip and fall down?
Kids science answer for "itsy bitsy spider rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Spiders do not slip because each tiny foot is covered in thousands of microscopic hairs that grip microscopic bumps on even the smoothest glass and metal spouts.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
